name: Alex Bató
reason: Semmelweis profile is a coherent health-outcomes record: repeated EQ-5D measurement/validation studies, Hungarian SF-36 and PROMIS norms, and QOL research with Rencz and Brodszky directly fit the EQ-HWB projects.

name: Alexander Arons
reason: The record coherently supports a valuation-methods researcher: health-state valuation, QALY measurement, visual analogue scale recalibration, probabilistic choice models, and EQ-related quality-of-life work. The Krabbe coauthor cluster reinforces this fit.

name: Alexander Geissler
reason: Although the health-policy/hospital-payment papers could fit PROM dashboards, the profile is substantially mixed: a large neuroimaging/MRI coauthor cluster plus unrelated works from 1959 and 1965–68 are incompatible with one coherent researcher record.

name: Alexander van Heusden
reason: Recent adapted EQ-5D-Y papers fit the project, but the profile has substantial conflicting material: its dominant cardiac-arrest/cardiogenetics cluster has a separate dense coauthor network, alongside unrelated 1963 and 2007 obstetric works. Safe attribution is not possible.

name: Alice Yu
reason: This is a Chang Gung University molecular-oncology profile dominated by neuroblastoma, anti-GD2 immunotherapy, glycosylation, and leukemia research. It is incompatible with the CHERE member's EQ-5D valuation, DCE, and EQ-HWB project record.
